start.text: Greetings, traveler! What can I do for you?
options: What can you tell me about this place?

info_place.text: Not much, I'm afraid. I'm just passing through myself.

start.text: Welcome to the Yawning Portal. I am Durnan, the owner. Can I offer you something to drink?
options: What can you tell me about this place?
Have you heard any interesting rumors lately?

offer_beer.text: Here is a fine dark beer for you. That will be 2 gold coins.
options: Thanks! What can you tell me about this place?
Have you heard any interesting rumors lately?

info_tavern.text: The Yawning Portal is the favorite meeting place of adventurers and merchants. Below us is the entrance to the infamous Undermountain, though I would advise anyone against venturing down there without proper preparation.
options: Tell me more about the dungeon.
Who are the interesting people who frequent the tavern?

info_dungeon.text: Undermountain is a deadly labyrinth beneath the city. Many enter, few leave... at least in one piece. If you are interested in exploring it, talk to Elminster; he is sitting in the corner. He knows far more than I do about those cursed halls.
options: I will speak with him, thanks.

clients_info.text: Well, Elminster often comes in for a drink; he is that old man in the corner with the white beard. There is also Mirt, a wealthy merchant who knows all the trading news in the city.

rumors_info.text: Lately there is a lot of talk about strange happenings at the market. Objects vanishing, noises in the night... and some say they have seen hooded cultists prowling the streets. But you know how rumors are; often exaggerated.
options: Do you know anything else about these cultists?
Interesting, I will keep my eyes open.

cultists_info.text: No, but if you are truly interested, talk to Violet at the market. She has a spice stall and sees everything that happens in the square.

info_general.text: What would you like to know? I can give you information about Waterdeep, the tavern patrons, or the infamous dungeon beneath us.
options: Who are the tavern's interesting patrons?
What do you know about the dungeon?

info_waterdeep.text: Waterdeep is the greatest city on the Sword Coast, ruled by the Masked Lords and the Open Lord, Dagult Neverember. It is a center of trade, magic, and political intrigue. If you are looking for something, you will probably find it here... for the right price.

start.text: Hmm? Oh, greetings, young adventurer. I am Elminster, a humble scholar of the arcane arts. How can I be of service?
options: Durnan told me you know a great deal about Undermountain.
Are you really THE famous Elminster?
Do you need help with any task?

info_dungeon.text: Ah, the infamous Undermountain. A labyrinth of dangers and forgotten treasures. Created by the mad wizard Halaster Blackcloak centuries ago, it is full of monsters, traps, and magical relics. If you mean to explore it, I advise you to obtain at least a map of the upper levels.
options: Do you know where I can find a map?

info_map.text: Hmm, Durnan might have a copy, though he will not part with it easily. Or you could speak with Mirt, that merchant over there. Another option is to visit the black market, but be careful not to be fooled by false maps.

creature_info.text: Oh, Undermountain holds all manner of things: from simple goblins to powerful beholders. In the upper levels you will find mostly undead, goblinoids, and the occasional aberrant beast. But the deeper you go, the stranger and more dangerous the creatures become.
options: Do you have any other advice for an adventurer?

advice_info.text: Never venture out alone. Always carry rope, extra torches, and at least one healing potion. And remember: sometimes fleeing is the best strategy. Here, take this healing potion; it may serve you well.

identity_info.text: *smiles enigmatically* I am just an old man who has seen many things in this world. The stories about me are often exaggerated. But tell me, what brings you to Waterdeep?
options: I am in search of adventure and riches.
I am seeking knowledge of the arcane arts.
Just passing through, exploring the world.

adventure_answer.text: Ah, the eternal call of gold and glory. Many before you have followed this path. Some became legendary heroes, others... well, food for worms. The difference often lies in caution and wisdom, not merely in the strength of your arm.
options: Do you have any advice for me?

magic_answer.text: A noble goal. Magic is as powerful as it is dangerous. If you are sincerely interested in arcane study, I could give you access to some basic texts. They are nothing extraordinary, but they might aid you on your path.
options: I would be very interested, thank you!

passage_answer.text: The journey itself is often more important than the destination. I have traveled through many realms and still find wonders that surprise me. May the winds be favorable to you, traveler.

offer_book.text: Here, this is an old manual of basic spells. Take good care of it; it contains knowledge precious to an aspiring wizard.
options: I will study it carefully, thank you!

offer_help.text: Hmm, now that you mention it... I need some rare herbs for my studies. A plant called 'Moon's Eye' grows in the woods north of the city. If you could procure me a few leaves, I would be most grateful.
options: Of course, I will bring them as soon as I can.
I am sorry, I am busy with other matters at the moment.

accept_quest.text: Excellent! The leaves are recognizable by their silvery-blue color, and they glow faintly at night. Be careful; the woods are not always safe. Return to me when you have found them.

start.text: Greetings, friend! Mirt the Merchant at your service. Are you looking for some business, or simply information?
options: What kind of business do you offer?
I was told you might have a map of Undermountain.
I am looking for information about the local market.
Violet sent me with a warning about the hooded figures.
Tell me about the sealed vault beneath the warehouse.
Tell me about the sealed vault beneath the warehouse.
Tell me about the sealed vault beneath the warehouse.
What did you do with the sigil?
You look worried. What troubles you?
What will happen to the trade road now?
You mentioned a sealed sanctum beneath the Underroad.
Any work for a trusted friend?
You do not recognize me, merchant.
I know a fence when I see one.
Those rune-marks are older than the city.
One of your merchants is selling cursed relics.

business_info.text: I have contacts with merchants all along the Sword Coast. I can procure almost anything, from the finest elven wine to dwarven armor. It depends on how much you are willing to spend and, sometimes, on the favors you can do.
options: Do you have anything interesting at the moment?
Not interested at the moment, thanks.

violet_warning_turn_in.text: Mirt's smile fades. 'Violet sent you? Then it is worse than I thought.' He hears you out, then nods. 'Tell her I will watch the warehouse - and here, for your trouble.'

sentinel_sigil_offer.text: Mirt lowers his voice. 'There is a sealed vault under the old warehouse. The warehouse key Violet gave you opens a strongbox there; the Vault Key inside opens the vault door. An iron sentinel guards the relic - Sentinel's Edge. Bring it to me and we will both profit.'
options: I will bring you the relic.

sentinel_sigil_accept.text: Good. The strongbox is in the warehouse; the sentinel carries the key to the reliquary. Try not to wake the whole cult.
options: I will return with Sentinel's Edge.

sentinel_sigil_reminder.text: The sealed vault is beneath the warehouse. Use the warehouse key on the strongbox for the Vault Key, then open the Vault Door. The sentinel carries the key to the reliquary.

sentinel_sigil_turn_in.text: Mirt turns the rune-etched blade in the light. 'Sentinel's Edge. I had begun to think the vault would keep it.' He pays you and presses a heavy silver signet into your hand.

sentinel_sigil_done.text: The sigil is already sold, but Mirt raises his cup. 'The vault is open and my purse is heavier. Not a bad day's work.'

waystation_offer.text: Mirt taps the map. 'The trade road east of the market has gone quiet. A bandit chief has taken the Broken Waystation and is bleeding my caravans dry. Clear him out and I will make it worth your while.'

waystation_accept.text: The waystation sits at the far end of the Trade Road. Expect a chief and at least a pair of cutthroats; the road itself is not safe either. Come back when the road is open.
options: I will return when it is done.

waystation_reminder.text: Follow the Trade Road east from the market. The Broken Waystation is at the far end. The chief will not give it up without a fight, so carry potions and keep your guard up.

waystation_turn_in.text: Mirt listens to your account, then sets a heavy purse on the table. 'The road is open again. That is worth more than coin to me, but take this anyway.'

waystation_done.text: Mirt's caravans have started moving again. 'If you find more trouble on that road, I want to hear about it before it reaches my ledgers.'
options: I will keep my eyes open.

underroad_reminder.text: Mirt taps the ledger. 'The tunnel beneath the waystation is older than the bandits. If the Smuggler Lord is using it, every quiet road in the region is for sale.'

underroad_turn_in.text: Mirt reads the names in the ledger twice, then closes it. 'The Underroad is clear and the buyers will scatter. That is worth more than the coin, but take this anyway.'

underroad_done.text: Mirt has already begun tracing the names from the ledger. 'The Underroad is quiet for now. If another buyer appears, I will know where to send you.'

sanctum_offer.text: Mirt sets down his cup. 'The smugglers' signet is not just a badge. It opens a sealed sanctum beyond their cache. Something old is waking down there - my sources call it the Rune Warden. End it and the eastern road is finally ours.'

sanctum_accept.text: Take the signet from the smugglers' cache if you have not already. Beyond it lies a warded hall; a Rune-Ward charm would make the threshold easier. The Rune Warden will not yield without a fight.
options: I will return when it is done.

sanctum_reminder.text: The sealed sanctum is beyond the Underroad's cache. The signet wakes the door; the Rune-Ward Amulet can quiet the ward. The Rune Warden is the last thing standing between the road and a quiet season.

sanctum_turn_in.text: Mirt listens without interrupting. When you finish, he pours two cups and pushes one across the table. 'The Rune Warden is gone. The road is quiet for the first time in years. That is worth more than coin - but take this anyway.'
options: A good end to a long road.

sanctum_done.text: The sealed sanctum is silent, and Mirt's caravans no longer need an escort past the Waystation. 'If the road ever wakes again,' he says, 'I know who to call.'

mirt_trusted.text: Mirt leans back and studies you. 'A trusted friend. That is a rare thing in this city.' He taps the table. 'Keep your purse full of potions and your name clean, and my people will keep their prices kind.'

disguise_bluff.text: Mirt squints at your borrowed face, then laughs. 'A new face, but the same boots. Sit down before someone less friendly notices.' Your illusion holds long enough to carry the bluff, then fades.

background_criminal.text: Mirt's eyes flick to your hands, then to the door. 'A professional. Good.' He lowers his voice. 'Gundren keeps a lockbox under his stall with a false plate. If you ever need leverage on him, that is where it lives.'

background_sage.text: Mirt turns a sealed ledger toward you. 'These marks are not merchant script. They are older than the city.' You recognize the same angular forms carved into the sanctum and the Runeheart vault below it.
options: The gate below is connected to them.
I will keep that in mind.

silent_partner_offer.text: Mirt's smile disappears. 'Gundren has been moving cursed relics through my market and undercutting every honest trader in it. His private ledger is in a lockbox beneath his stall. Bring it to me and we will settle this quietly.'

silent_partner_accept.text: Gundren keeps his stall near the fountain. The lockbox is beneath it. Be discreet; a public accusation would cost me more than the relics are worth.

silent_partner_reminder.text: The lockbox is beneath Gundren's stall in the market. Bring me the ledger and I will decide how much of this becomes public.

silent_partner_turn_in.text: Mirt reads the ledger in silence. 'This is enough to ruin him. Or enough to own him. What shall we do with it?'

silent_partner_mirt.text: Mirt closes the ledger and pours two cups. 'The market will be cleaner by morning. You have my thanks, and my coin.'

silent_partner_underroad.text: Mirt studies you, then laughs without warmth. 'So the smugglers keep their merchant. I will remember this.' The ledger vanishes into the Underroad's network, and a heavy purse finds your hand.

silent_partner_keep.text: You close the ledger and put it away. Mirt's expression hardens. 'A dangerous thing to carry. Do not expect me to forget where it went.'

silent_partner_done.text: Gundren's stall stands quiet, and Mirt's ledgers balance again. 'The market remembers who settled that account,' he says. 'So do I.'

show_items.text: At the moment I have a fine healing potion, only 30 gold coins. And this amulet of protection, for 60. Interested?
options: I am interested in the healing potion.
I would like the amulet of protection.

buy_potion.text: Excellent choice! Here is your healing potion.
options: Thanks! Do you have anything else to offer?
That is all for now, thanks.

buy_amulet.text: An excellent investment in your safety! Here is the amulet.
options: Thanks! Do you have anything else to offer?
That is all for now, thanks.

favors_info.text: Oh, nothing illegal! *smiles* Sometimes I need help delivering packages to dangerous places, or recovering goods from... reluctant merchants. The kind of work an adventurer is perfect for.
options: Do you have any work available now?
I am not interested in this kind of work.

offer_work.text: As a matter of fact, yes. A client has not paid an important debt. His name is Vargas, and he lives in the eastern part of the city. Nothing violent; I just want you to remind him of his... moral responsibility.
options: I will take care of Vargas.
That is not the kind of work for me.

accept_job.text: Excellent! Once you have spoken with him, come back here for your reward: 50 gold coins. And if he gives you the money directly, even better; you can keep 10%.

vargas_debt_reminder.text: Vargas is hiding in the old warehouse at the eastern edge of the market. He still owes me, and I do not forget a debt.

vargas_debt_turn_in.text: So Vargas has paid at last. A pity it took steel to make him remember. Here is your fifty gold, as promised.
options: What happens to the cult now?

vargas_debt_done.text: The debt is settled, and Vargas will not trouble honest merchants again. If you hear whispers about who was buying his smuggled goods, I would like to know.
options: I will keep my eyes open.

vargas_followup.text: Vargas was only a collector. Someone in the city paid for what his cult carried out of the warehouse. A silent partner, and a patient one. That is a name worth finding.

ask_map.text: Ah, Undermountain... yes, I might have something like that. *lowers his voice* It costs 100 gold coins. It is an authentic map of the first three levels, very detailed. Are you interested?
options: It is too expensive for me at the moment.

buy_map.text: Deal! Here is your map. Use it wisely, and do not tell anyone you got it from me.

info_market.text: The market of Waterdeep is the largest on the Sword Coast! You will find everything: from Calimshan fabrics to dwarven-forged weapons, from magic potions to exotic spices. But watch out for pickpockets; they are everywhere.
options: Have you noticed anything strange at the market lately?

strange_info.text: Hmm... now that you mention it, yes. There have been some mysterious thefts. Objects vanishing without a trace, even when well guarded. And some merchants have seen hooded figures prowling about at night. Bizarre, is it not?
options: Very strange. I will keep my eyes open.

start.text: Violet looks up from a tray of dried herbs. 'You are the one asking about the hooded figures, yes? Good. I have seen them.'
options: Durnan said you have seen strange things around the market.
I am on my way to the warehouse.
Is there anything else I can do?
I have walked the trade road before.
I have tended the sick before.
The Watch could use someone like you.
I heard the Watch has a corruption problem.

strange_info.text: Three nights running, hooded figures slipped into the old warehouse at the edge of the square. They carry crates in and nothing comes out. I am a healer, not a soldier, but I know poisons and I will not stand by while they poison this market.

warehouse_info.text: Old cargo, smuggled herbs, and worse. The man leading them is Vargas. He owes Mirt money, and now he pays his debt in favours to something far worse. If we break his cell, the market may breathe again.

accept_quest.text: Take this antidote - and the warehouse key I lifted from one of the hooded figures. I am coming with you. I can fight, and my herbs may keep us both alive. The warehouse is at the eastern edge of the market; look for the old loading door.
options: Let us go to the warehouse.

violet_trusted.text: Violet smiles without looking up from her herbs. 'The Watch remembers who stood with us when the warehouse was full of knives. My door is open to you.'

background_outlander.text: Violet studies the road dust on your boots. 'You know the old paths, then. Watch the grass east of the waystation; the bandits there have learned to wait without a fire. An Outlander sees the signs before the ambush closes.'

background_acolyte.text: Violet pauses over a tray of dried herbs. 'You have the look of a temple healer. If the smoke gets into your lungs, do not try to pray it out. Water, salt and a clean cloth first. Faith can follow.'

watchman_offer.text: Violet lowers her voice. 'Watch Sergeant Vell has been selling confiscated goods back to the smugglers. The proof is in a watch cache hidden in the old warehouse. Bring me the ledger and I can put him in front of the Watch.'

watchman_accept.text: The cache is behind the old crates in the warehouse. Vell is careful, but he is not clever. Bring the ledger back to me.

watchman_reminder.text: The watch cache is in the old warehouse, behind the crates. The ledger inside names every buyer Vell sold to.

watchman_turn_in.text: Violet weighs the ledger in one hand. 'This is enough to break him. What do you want to do with it?'

watchman_violet.text: Violet takes the ledger and nods once. 'The Watch will answer for this. Thank you.' She presses a purse into your hand.

watchman_mirt.text: Mirt turns the ledger over and smiles. 'Vell has been a problem for several of my people. I will make sure this reaches the right desk.' He adds a pouch of coin.

watchman_keep.text: You close your hand around the ledger. Violet studies you, then steps back. 'I hoped you would trust the Watch. Keep it, then, but do not mistake silence for safety.'

watchman_done.text: Violet has already begun rebuilding the Watch's evidence room. 'Vell is finished. The next corrupt badge will think twice before using the warehouse.'

warning_offer.text: If you are passing through the tavern, tell Mirt to watch the warehouse. He trusts the wrong people, and he will not hear it from me.
options: I will carry the warning to Mirt.

warning_accept.text: Thank you. Mirt keeps a table near the back of the Yawning Portal. Tell him the hooded figures are real.

warning_reminder.text: Mirt is usually in the tavern. Tell him the hooded figures are real - and that he should stop protecting old friends.

shadows_reminder.text: The old warehouse is at the eastern edge of the market, past the last stalls. I will be right behind you. Do not let Vargas reach the crates.

shadows_turn_in.text: You did it! The market can breathe again. Here is what I promised - and thank you. I would not have dared face them alone.

shadows_done.text: The cult is broken, but Vargas was only the hand that moved the crates. Someone in the city paid for what he smuggled. A silent partner, still out there.

shadows_followup.text: Only a name half-heard over the crates: 'the Silent Partner.' Whoever it is has money and patience. If you find them, come back - I will have a few more antidotes ready.
options: I will keep my eyes open.

shop_info.text: Antidotes, salves, and a few herbs that are better not named aloud. If you are going into that warehouse, you will want an antidote more than perfume.
options: Tell me about the hooded figures.

start.text: A wiry runner steps out of the tunnel shadows. 'You are the one who walked through the Lord's hall and came out breathing. The Watch took our medicine wagon before the dust settled. I need someone with clean hands and a reason to be near the old warehouse.'
options: What happened to the tunnel families?

nessa_info.text: Nessa turns her wrist, showing the old Watch brand beneath a leather cuff. 'I ran cargo for the Lord because the tunnel pays better than the docks. When he fell, the Watch finally remembered our names. They took the wagon and called it evidence. The families below just call it winter.'

quiet_cargo_offer.text: The wagon is parked beside the old warehouse, under a canvas tarp. The manifest is in a false bottom under the driver's bench; without it, the Watch can hold the cargo for months. Bring it to me and I can make sure the medicine reaches the tunnel families - or you can decide who deserves the leverage.

quiet_cargo_accept.text: Search the wagon itself; the tarp hides more than cargo. Once you have the manifest, come back to the Underroad. The Watch will not miss it until the next shift change.

quiet_cargo_reminder.text: The impound wagon is parked beside the old warehouse in the market. Search near it; the false bottom is hidden under the driver's bench. Bring the manifest back to the Underroad.

quiet_cargo_turn_in.text: Nessa reads the manifest twice, then looks up. 'Medicine, blankets, lamp oil. The Watch will call it contraband, but the tunnel will call it winter. What do you want to do with it?'

quiet_cargo_nessa.text: Nessa folds the manifest into her sleeve. 'The runners will remember this. So will the families.' She presses a flat courier's satchel into your hands, its hidden pockets already heavy with a few coins.

quiet_cargo_violet.text: Nessa listens, then nods once. 'The Watch healer is fair. She will make sure the medicine is logged, not lost.' A runner carries the manifest into the market, and Violet's people send back a purse and a receipt stamped with the Watch seal.
options: The Watch owes the tunnel that much.

quiet_cargo_mirt.text: Nessa laughs without much humour. 'Mirt will sell the route back to us before the ink dries. Still, coin spends the same.' The manifest disappears into Mirt's network, and a heavy purse arrives before the next bell.

quiet_cargo_done.text: Nessa is counting crates with two other runners. 'The tunnel families have medicine again. The Watch has its paperwork. Mirt has his cut, if that is the road you chose. The Underroad remembers who moved the cargo.'
